title: Bubbling Brine Spring
description: Warm saltwater wells up from a crack in the cavern floor, filling the air with mineral steam. Thick deposits of crystallized salt ring the pool in uneven ridges. The water carries a faint sulphurous tang, but the warmth is undeniably inviting.

choices.label: Harvest the salt deposits
choices.description: The crusted mineral formations break off in clean chunks.

outcomes.text: The deposits crack away in satisfying slabs. Pure crystallized sea salt, dense and valuable.
The outer crust yields decent crystals, though the deeper layers are too fused to the rock.
A sudden geyser erupts from the crack as you chip too close. Scalding brine sprays across the party.

choices.label: Bottle the brine
choices.description: Concentrated brine from a thermal vent holds potent venom properties.

outcomes.text: You carefully fill vials with the concentrated brine. The liquid practically hums with toxic potency.
The brine is potent but the spring flow is slow. You fill what vials you can.
The sulphurous fumes grow thick as you lean in. Your head swims and your hands shake, but you manage to fill a single vial.

choices.label: Bathe in the spring
choices.description: The warm mineral water eases wounds and restores vitality.

outcomes.text: The party soaks in the warm brine. Cuts close, bruises fade, and even old aches melt away. Bliss.
The water soothes some wounds, though the sulphur smell clings to everyone for hours afterward.
